notes: 'then' is added: unlike JER.8.22 there is no כִּי in this clause to license it, and no waw either, so rule 55's and rule 51's surplus reasoning both point the same way.
The article on הָעָם and the agreement article on הַזֶּה go unrepresented; the demonstrative morpheme takes the single written determiner, as in JER.8.1 and JER.8.3.
The supplied 'of' before Jerusalem stays with the appositional name, since no other morpheme in the clause licenses a relational word.

בַּתַּרְמִית is rule 40's promoted object: the preposition and its assimilated article are both unrepresented while תַּרְמִית takes 'deceit'. Partition and heads verified across 16 source and 21 target ids.
